# The Portal's dist/development and dist/production tabs open DevIndex's own entries

## Context

DevIndex now serves `dist/development` and `dist/production` from their own entries under `neomjs.com/devindex/` (neomjs/devindex#62, merged 2026-10-06). Read live at 16:46Z: both entries paint the contributor grid and the learn view from the site's own index, with no failed request (neomjs/devindex#61, comment 6021047925). The Portal's four registries still link every DevIndex row to the site root, which is production's entry, so the dist/development tab opens the production build.

Registries reach the live Portal only inside a release package, so this has to merge before the 13.2 cut to ship with it.

## The Problem

`apps/portal/resources/data/examples_{devmode,dist_dev,dist_esm,dist_prod}.json` all carry `"url": "https://neomjs.com/devindex/"` for the GitHub Meritocracy Index row (#19184). `TabContainerController.spec.mjs` pins that URL for every registry ("every environment links out to its own deployed site").

## The Architectural Reality

- DevIndex's `deploy-receipt.json` lists the entries it shipped (`entries`, since neomjs/devindex#62).
- The other two environments, dist/esm and dev mode, do not boot under the mount until DevIndex builds against 13.2. That needs this release's esm build and #19430. neomjs/devindex#61 owns them, and their rows stay on the site root until it delivers.

## The Fix

- `examples_dist_dev.json`: the DevIndex row's `url` becomes `https://neomjs.com/devindex/dist/development/apps/devindex/`.
- `examples_dist_prod.json`: the DevIndex row's `url` becomes `https://neomjs.com/devindex/dist/production/apps/devindex/`, the same path shape as every other `dist_prod` row.
- The spec pins each registry's DevIndex URL: the two entries above, and the site root for `devmode` and `dist_esm`.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The `dist_dev` and `dist_prod` rows open DevIndex's own entries; `devmode` and `dist_esm` stay on the site root.
- [ ] `TabContainerController.spec.mjs` pins all four, red on `dev` for the two changed rows.
- [ ] Both URLs return 200 and paint the grid on neomjs.com (headless probe) before the merge.

## Out of Scope

- The `devmode` and `dist_esm` rows (neomjs/devindex#61, after DevIndex moves to 13.2).

## Related

#19184 (the rows), neomjs/devindex#62, neomjs/devindex#61, #19430.
